t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will always appear in pairs, but not necessarily in the same order.Some gnomes will lead you a colourful forest and some gnomes will lead to a dark forest. This is determined by the colour of the gnome and not sizes or other characteristics. The aim is to collect as many mushrooms as possible.orange, green, red and blue gnomes will lead to a colourful forest and brown, pink, yellow and puple gnome will lead to a dark forest.

vb_textbox.text: Hi, here is some important advice that is worth reading through and understanding before you start the game.Firstly the ghomes will appear in fixed pairs : orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow and lue & purple. They will always appear as one of those pairs but they may change positions within those pairs.Each gnome within a pair will lead you to a different forest, either a bright one with a red basket or a dark forest with a yellow basket. Orange, green, red and blue gnomes lead to a bright forest and brown, pink, yellow and puple gnomes lead to a dark forest. You should aim to always reach the forest with the most mushrooms. Please note the number of mushrooms in each forest constantly changes.All othe characteristics of the gnomes is not important, it is just the colour of the gnomes you need to focus on.Good luck!
